message:
Now let me configure and build libass with ASAN.

<｜｜DSML｜｜>
<parameter=command>cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/libass && export PKG_CONFIG_PATH=/workspace/repo-vul/work-vul/lib/pkgconfig && CFLAGS="-fsanitize=address -g -O1" CXXFLAGS="-fsanitize=address -g -O1" LDFLAGS="-fsanitize=address" ./configure --disable-asm --disable-shared --enable-static 2>&1 | tail -20</｜｜DSML｜｜>
</｜｜DSML｜｜>
